purpose: Fresh-start registry containing only the three user-authorized research-family labels and experimental safeguards. No inherited formula implementation, source pointer, tuned weight, or historical result is permitted.

A->B->C.research_scope: Research-family label only. Define and implement from scratch; no inherited legacy implementation.

promotion_requirements: Define the exact mathematical/algorithmic method from scratch before implementation.
Use only strictly pre-target draws during discovery, fitting, and selection.
Add deterministic synthetic unit tests before real-archive evaluation.
Run forward walk-forward, reverse retrospective stress testing, and time-ordered cross-validation as separately labelled protocols.
Compare against an appropriate random/null baseline and report uncertainty; mean hits alone are not proof.
Do not promote a method from OPEN_DEFINITION without explicit user approval.
